newsitem.title: UK: British Energy CEO Hawley to leave co.
newsitem.headline: British Energy CEO Hawley to leave co.

text.p: British Energy Plc said on Monday its chief executive, Robert Hawley, would leave the company, effective June 30.
The company said non-executive chairman John Robb would take over as executive chairman until the appointment of a new chief executive, expected before the end of the year.

"The board have recently been discussing the question of management succession given the age profile of the board. Against this background, Bob Hawley indicated he would prefer to develop his other interests," British Energy said in a statement.
The firm's shares were down 12p at 146.5 by 1300 GMT in an overall weak market in London.
